RIR.TITLE: RIR (Reps in Reserve)
RIR.DESCRIPTION: Shows how many more reps you could do before reaching muscle failure. For example, finishing a set at RIR 2 means you could have done 2 more reps before failing.

LEVELS.text: Couldn't complete one more rep, however hard I tried
The last rep barely went up; another one would not have
I had 1 rep left, and it would have been hard
I had 3 left: demanding, but with clear margin
Comfortable set, still far from the limit
Very far from failure: useful for technique or warm-up

MICROCYCLE.TITLE: Microcycle
MICROCYCLE.DESCRIPTION: A block of consecutive days (training and rest) that you define yourself — it doesn't have to be a week, it lasts as long as you decide. When you finish a microcycle, the next one begins and so on in a cyclic manner.

ONE_RM.TITLE: 1RM (One-Rep Max)
ONE_RM.DESCRIPTION: The heaviest weight you could lift for a single rep with good form. It's used as a reference to calculate the weight for your training sets.

BEST_SET.TITLE: Best set
BEST_SET.DESCRIPTION: The heaviest weight you lifted in a single set of this exercise, compared between the two selected microcycles. The arrow and color show whether it went up or down, and the percentage shows how much it changed.

EFFECTIVE_VOLUME.TITLE: Effective volume
EFFECTIVE_VOLUME.DESCRIPTION: Weight times reps for each set, but giving more weight to sets done close to failure (low RIR) than to sets further from it. This reflects the real training stimulus better than total volume. Compared between the two selected microcycles: the arrow and color show whether it went up or down, and the percentage shows how much it changed.

TOTAL_VOLUME.TITLE: Actual volume
TOTAL_VOLUME.DESCRIPTION: Weight times reps added up across every set of this exercise, without weighting by how close you were to failure — unlike effective volume, an easy set counts the same as one taken to the limit here. Useful to see how much total weight you moved.

DROP_SET.TITLE: Drop set (DS)
DROP_SET.DESCRIPTION: When you reach failure (or close to it) you drop the weight without resting and keep doing reps. Each weight drop within the same set is a "drop" — numbered (Drop 1, Drop 2...) under the main set.

REST_PAUSE.TITLE: Rest-pause (RP)
REST_PAUSE.DESCRIPTION: When you reach failure (or close to it) you rest a few seconds with the same weight and squeeze out a few more reps, repeating several times. Each block of reps after the pause is numbered (RP 1, RP 2...) under the main set.

SETS_COMPARISON.TITLE: Sets
SETS_COMPARISON.DESCRIPTION: Number of completed sets of this exercise, compared between the two selected microcycles.

PINNED_NOTE.TITLE: Pinned note
PINNED_NOTE.DESCRIPTION: Stays fixed to this exercise throughout all the routine's microcycles. Great for technique reminders or adjustments you always want visible here.

SET_OBJECTIVE.TITLE: Target set
SET_OBJECTIVE.DESCRIPTION: Define the mark you expect to reach in the set here. During training you can record what was actually done and set it as completed.

weight.LABEL: Weight
weight.HINT: When you get up, after using the bathroom and before breakfast. Always on the same day of the week.

muscle_mass.LABEL: Muscle mass
muscle_mass.HINT: From the bioimpedance scale, under the same conditions as your weight.

fat_mass.LABEL: Fat mass
fat_mass.HINT: From the bioimpedance scale, under the same conditions as your weight.

bone_mass.LABEL: Bone mass
bone_mass.HINT: From the bioimpedance scale, under the same conditions as your weight.

residual_mass.LABEL: Residual mass
residual_mass.HINT: From the bioimpedance scale, under the same conditions as your weight.

perimeter_neck.LABEL: Neck
perimeter_neck.HINT: Just below the Adam's apple, with the tape level and the neck relaxed.

perimeter_shoulders.LABEL: Shoulders
perimeter_shoulders.HINT: Around the widest part of the shoulders, standing with arms hanging.

perimeter_chest.LABEL: Chest
perimeter_chest.HINT: At nipple height, after breathing out normally.

perimeter_waist.LABEL: Waist
perimeter_waist.HINT: At the narrowest part, between the lowest rib and the hip. Don't suck in.

perimeter_navel.LABEL: Navel
perimeter_navel.HINT: Exactly at navel height. Don't suck in or hold your breath.

perimeter_hip.LABEL: Hip
perimeter_hip.HINT: Around the widest part of the glutes, standing with feet together.

perimeter_bicep_relaxed_l.LABEL: Relaxed biceps L
perimeter_bicep_relaxed_l.HINT: Arm hanging relaxed, at the widest part.

perimeter_bicep_relaxed_r.LABEL: Relaxed biceps R
perimeter_bicep_relaxed_r.HINT: Arm hanging relaxed, at the widest part.

perimeter_bicep_flexed_l.LABEL: Flexed biceps L
perimeter_bicep_flexed_l.HINT: Elbow at 90° and biceps squeezed, at the widest part.

perimeter_bicep_flexed_r.LABEL: Flexed biceps R
perimeter_bicep_flexed_r.HINT: Elbow at 90° and biceps squeezed, at the widest part.

perimeter_quad_l.LABEL: Quadriceps L
perimeter_quad_l.HINT: A hand's width above the knee, standing with weight on both feet.

perimeter_quad_r.LABEL: Quadriceps R
perimeter_quad_r.HINT: A hand's width above the knee, standing with weight on both feet.

perimeter_thigh_relaxed.LABEL: Relaxed thigh
perimeter_thigh_relaxed.HINT: Just below the glute, standing with the leg relaxed.

perimeter_thigh_flexed.LABEL: Flexed thigh
perimeter_thigh_flexed.HINT: At the same spot as the relaxed thigh, squeezing the leg.

perimeter_calf_l.LABEL: Calf L
perimeter_calf_l.HINT: At the widest part, standing with weight on both feet.

perimeter_calf_r.LABEL: Calf R
perimeter_calf_r.HINT: At the widest part, standing with weight on both feet.

perimeter_ankle_l.LABEL: Ankle L
perimeter_ankle_l.HINT: At the narrowest part, just above the bone.

perimeter_ankle_r.LABEL: Ankle R
perimeter_ankle_r.HINT: At the narrowest part, just above the bone.

recovery_between_sessions.LABEL: Recovery between sessions
ANCHORS: I start the next session as tired as I finished the last one
I only half recover: I carry fatigue into the next session
I'm recovered, but only just
I'm recovered with room to spare
I'm fully fresh, I could have trained sooner

training_adherence.LABEL: Training adherence
ANCHORS: I didn't do any session
I did less than half of the sessions
I did about half
I did almost all of them, with some changes
I did every session exactly as planned

hunger_satiety.LABEL: Hunger and fullness
ANCHORS: Constantly hungry, I think about food all day
I'm still hungry after meals
I finish satisfied and last well until the next meal
I struggle to finish some meals
There's too much food, I eat without appetite

hydration_level.LABEL: Hydration
ANCHORS: I barely drink water, I'm often thirsty
I drink little, I only remember now and then
I drink a normal amount, without keeping count
I drink steadily throughout the day
I drink the prescribed amount every day

stress_level.LABEL: Stress level
ANCHORS: Calm, nothing is getting to me
Some occasional tension that passes
Constant background stress, but manageable
Quite stressed, I find it hard to switch off
Overwhelmed: it affects my sleep and appetite

motivation_level.LABEL: Motivation
ANCHORS: Even opening the app is hard
I train out of obligation
I'm getting it done, nothing more
Keen most days
Very keen, plenty of motivation

sleep_hours.LABEL: Weekly sleep hours
sleep_hours.HINT: Add up the hours you slept this week and divide by 7.

sleep_quality.LABEL: Sleep quality
ANCHORS: I wake up several times and get up wrecked
I sleep badly: I struggle to fall or stay asleep
I sleep so-so, neither well nor badly
I sleep well most nights
I sleep through and wake up rested

general_fatigue.LABEL: General tiredness
ANCHORS: Energetic all day
A bit tired late in the day
Tired in the afternoon, within normal
Tired most of the day
Exhausted: normal life is hard

nutrition_plan_adherence.LABEL: Nutrition plan adherence
ANCHORS: I didn't follow the plan
I followed it on less than half of the days
I followed it on about half of the days
I followed it almost every day
I followed it every day

urine_color.LABEL: Urine colour
urine_color.HINT: Check it mid-morning, not the first urine of the day. 1 to 3 means well hydrated; 4 to 5, drink more; 6 or higher, you are dehydrated.
ANCHORS: Clear, almost like water
Very pale yellow
Pale yellow
Straw yellow
Dark yellow
Amber
Dark amber
Light brown

progress_photos.LABEL: Progress photos
progress_photos.HINT: Same place, same light and same time. Fasted and in the same clothes. Phone at navel height, about 2 metres away.

BANDS.1: Mild discomfort, I barely notice it
BANDS.2: Mild pain: it distracts me, but I go about my day
BANDS.3: Moderate pain: it limits some movements
BANDS.4: Severe pain: I can't train that area
BANDS.5: Unbearable pain: I have to stop completely
